device: Apple M4 Pro, 20 GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory
public_default: CPU fitting unchanged; resident fitting and continuous workflow remain private experiments

phase_attribution.boundary: Instrumented GPU phase encoders and separate capture replays; not uninstrumented complete-call timings. Node-size phase bands classify mixed rounds by median rows per node; they do not attribute individual nodes time.
limitations: Encoder timestamps perturb scheduling and are not benchmark timings.
GPU shader sampling and phase timestamps come from separate executions.
Counter means restricted by shader windows are excluded: replay schedules need not contain identical nodes; they do not identify a phase-specific occupancy limiter.
Small-node bands count work, not separately timed individual nodes.

shader_study.boundary: Complete fitting including validation, scratch, partition, node/queue management, canonicalization and publication. GPU upload included. Input sampling, CPU input restoration, backend/domain and worker-pool creation excluded. Concurrent thread launch/join included. CPU seconds are process CPU time.

admission_study.boundary: Complete fitting including validation, scratch, partition, node/queue management, canonicalization and publication. GPU upload included. Input sampling, CPU input restoration, backend/domain and worker-pool creation excluded. Concurrent thread launch/join included. CPU seconds are process CPU time.

final_shader_study.boundary: Complete fitting including validation, scratch, partition, node/queue management, canonicalization and publication. GPU upload included. Input sampling, CPU input restoration, backend/domain and worker-pool creation excluded. Concurrent thread launch/join included. CPU seconds are process CPU time.

final_phase_comparison.boundary: Diagnostic phase-encoder timing, not benchmark elapsed time

excluded_or_intermediate_artifacts.phase-baseline-one-round: Stale metallib lacked tiled init and never ran the requested fitting operation; excluded.
excluded_or_intermediate_artifacts.metal-validation-initial.log: Instrumented shared storage exceeded 32 KiB; fixed by final 12 KiB prefix array.
excluded_or_intermediate_artifacts.phase-battery-comparison.json: Intermediate 16 KiB-prefix diagnostic; final paired diagnostic is phase-final-battery-comparison.json.

limitations: One Apple M4 Pro: AC prepared-sample studies and a separate matched battery full-image comparison; no cross-power speedup or general throughput claim.
CPU-fitting controls are hybrid pipelines with Metal feature/sample/token stages, not pure CPU encoders.
Managed backing is allocator accounting, not process RSS; peak committed bytes include reservations.
Summed overlapping job intervals are not thread CPU-seconds.
No simultaneous independent CPU-fit/GPU-fit throughput experiment or additive-throughput claim.
